signal: Filevine raised $400M and launched its Legal Operating Intelligence System (LOIS), an agentic AI console for law firms, with nearly 6,000 customers.

email.body1:
Rob, saw Filevine raised $400M and just launched the LOIS agentic AI console for law firms.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Filevine off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rob, quick follow-up for Filevine.

Post-raise, board expectations on enterprise pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise segment needs, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rob, last bit of proof for Filevine.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Filevine's reply rate likely compares to other well-funded software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rob, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Filevine either way.
